observations.inspectedFrom: Video frame of the YouTube unboxing UklA52rTpkc (Italian SET SNORLAX GX box, still sealed), screenshot supplied by the collection owner; WebP decoded losslessly to PNG
observations.observed: Sealed Italian 'SET SNORLAX GX' box: Italian booster packs ('GIOCO DI CARTE COLLEZIONABILI', '...ANTICHE'), a standard-size Snorlax (130 PS) and a standard-size Snorlax-GX card in the side windows, and in the top window a Snorlax-GX ('PS 190') far larger than the packs and the two standard cards beside them, i.e. the jumbo (oversized) printing of the Italian box. Holofoil visible in the window.

physicalObservation.basis: In the sealed Italian box the windowed Snorlax-GX is far larger than the booster packs and the two standard-size cards beside it; holofoil is visible.
